author: austinbaustinb
content:
As an update, I am currently focusing on getting the "show me" function to be quicker. Y'all might've noticed it kinda takes a few seconds between you asking for a pic and the bot actually replying.
Thats because the bot needs to:
1) Process your request and match it to the right cat
2) Access our google sheet and find the right file link
3) Run an auto-crop program on the image at that link
4) Reply to you with an embed of that cropped image and the image details.


Steps 2 and 3 are the slowest, google is not super speedy with this.
I was able to slightly work around that and kinda speed it up a bit if y'all wanna try it out in the next few minutes.

Tomcat will respond twice. once with a normal message, and a second is it replying directly to you (and pinging you).
The pinged reply is the old version, the normal message is the new one. You'll see the new version is a bit quicker. not instant but better.
